value.rationale: Theta graphs are natural test families of graph toric varieties with three independent even-cycle binomials. The exact singular component stratification, polynomial count varying with arm lengths, codimension threshold, and uniform transverse ordinary-node analytic type describe meaningful algebraic geometry not mechanically read from the generators; this is a motivated infinite-parameter classification.

scientific_limitations: Singular components characterized in codimension exactly three, not the entire scheme-theoretic singular locus or higher-codimension components.
